requirements.statement: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
requirements.source_quote: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined what a finance administrator is or how the role is assigned
Conflicts with line 2, which lets any user delete invoices they created

requirements.statement: Any user can delete invoices they created.
requirements.source_quote: Any user can delete invoices they created.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined whether this applies to invoices in every state (for example already sent or paid)
Conflicts with line 1, which restricts deletion to finance administrators

requirements.statement: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
requirements.source_quote: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined whether export covers single or multiple invoices
Conflicts with line 4, which requires export to Excel

requirements.statement: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined which users, or which invoice data the Excel file contains
Conflicts with line 3, which limits export to PDF only
Not defined whether removal is immediate or after a delay
Conflicts with line 6, which requires recoverability for 30 days

requirements.statement: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
requirements.source_quote: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined who may recover an invoice or how
Not defined what happens after 30 days
Conflicts with line 5, which says deletion is permanent

clarifying_questions.question: Who may delete an invoice: only finance administrators, or also any user for the invoices they created?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Decides the permission model for deletion; the two statements give opposite rules.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Deletion permissions cannot be specified; the wrong rule could let unauthorised users delete financial records.

clarifying_questions.question: Should invoices be exportable as PDF only, or also to Excel? If both, who can use each format?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: The statements contradict each other on supported export formats.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Export scope cannot be fixed; one format may be built or omitted wrongly.

clarifying_questions.question: When an invoice is deleted, is it removed permanently at once, or kept and recoverable for 30 days?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Decides whether deletion is reversible, which affects data retention and legal effect.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Deletion behaviour cannot be specified; an irreversible action could be built where recovery was expected.

clarifying_questions.question: If invoices are recoverable for 30 days, who can recover them, and what happens to them after 30 days?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Defines the recovery permissions and the end-of-retention behaviour.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Recovery flow and purge behaviour remain undefined.

conflicts.description: REQ-001 says only finance administrators can delete invoices; REQ-002 says any user can delete invoices they created. Both are kept unreconciled.
REQ-003 says invoices must be exported as PDF only; REQ-004 says users must be able to export invoices to Excel. Both are kept unreconciled.
REQ-005 says deleted invoices are removed permanently; REQ-006 says deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days. Both are kept unreconciled.
